value.title: Undecided Is Undecided and It`s Not a Decision
value.synopsis: The cast goes over their ideas for the series' new direction.

value.title: Milk Should Be in the Temperature Like Human Skin
value.synopsis: A baby is dropped off in front of the Yorozuya with a note claiming it's Gintoki's son.

value.title: Make an Appointment First Before Meeting With Someone
value.synopsis: It is revealed that the baby isn't Gintoki's; instead the baby was left at Yorozuya by the mother to keep her child safe from her father-in-law. Meanwhile Kagura and Shinpachi try to save the mother; Gintoki is on his way to return the baby.

value.title: Stress Causes Baldness. But, Paying Too Much Attention to Preventing Stress, Builds Up Stress Again. In the End There Is Nothing That We Can Do to it.
value.synopsis: While trying to burn old JUMP issues, Gintoki is captured by a female fire fighter in search of a local arsonist.

value.title: Mothers Are the Same No Matter Where They Are
value.synopsis: A mother looking for her son in Edo enlists the help of Yorozuya.

value.title: Do Not Make That "Kuchakucha" Sound When Eating
value.synopsis: Continuing from the last episode, it is discovered that the son turned out to be the No.1 "Pimp" in Kabuki District.

value.title: Take Note of the One-Day Director
value.synopsis: Terakado Tsu (Otsu) goes to be one day chief of the Shinsengumi to improve its image.

value.title: You Must Go Back to the Day of Action When You Were Looking for Lost Items
value.synopsis: Mutsu requests the Yorozuya recover some stolen cargo.

value.title: Croquette Bread Is Always Popular in Shops
value.synopsis: A serial killer has been going around town-- and one of the crew meets him head on! In the meantime, Gintoki is requested to locate "Benizakura", an unlucky sword stolen from its owner.

value.title: Do Not Forget Where You Left Your Umbrella
value.synopsis: Kagura gets captured.  Tetsuko goes to visit the injured Gintoki and tells him the truth about the Benizakura sword.

value.title: The Sun Will Rise
value.synopsis: Shinpachi and Elizabeth go on the ship to attack Okada.  A battle rages on the ship, at which Kagura manages to escape from captivity.  On the other hand, Gintoki and Tetsuko (Benizakura forger Tetsuya's sister) head towards Takasugi.

value.title: Insects at Night Gather in the Light
value.synopsis: The battle comes to a conclusion, with Benizakura finally taken over Okada's body, and Gintoki will have to use the sword Tetsuko gave him to stop this.

value.title: What You Want Is Not What You Get
value.synopsis: Yamasaki is sent by Hijikata to investigate what has happened with that fight between Katsura and Takasugi groups.  He goes around asking different people, though fails to get any real answers.

value.title: The Preview of the Next Edition of Jump Is Unreliable
value.synopsis: Hattori Zenzo has been hired to kidnap a girl who is able to foresee the future.  Meanwhile, the Yorozuya has been hired to protect the very same girl.

value.title: Eating Corn Is Unexpectedly Very Filling
value.synopsis: A set of TV crews follow Katsura around for a day to do a television program special interview.

value.title: The Boy Learns the Value of Life Through the Beetle
value.synopsis: Kagura's beetle was killed during a beetle fighting match.  She tries to drag Gintoki and Shinpachi to go beetle hunting with her.  That only succeeds when they know there is a high demand for the beetles - meaning they can make money of it.  The trio encounters the Shinsengumi who also happens to be capturing beetles for reason unknown.

value.title: Substance over Form
value.synopsis: An old dango shop owner accepts a challenge from the owner of a popular new dessert shop.

value.title: This Life That Continues to Run / Minami-chan Is Indeed the Ideal Girlfriend
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - Gintoki gets into an accident with a delivery girl who has the "Need for Speed".

Part 2 - As Gintoki recovers from the delivery incident, Sa-chan is forced to weigh both her feminine needs and her assassin duties when working a mission at the same hospital.

value.title: There Are Ghosts to Be Found Everywhere
value.synopsis: Every year during the Matsuri festival, a "Test of Courage" is held. This year Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura help out with the event.

value.title: Please Separate Your Garbage
value.synopsis: Gintoki finds a female android head in the trash.

value.title: Cute Things Become Disgusting When There Are Too Many
value.synopsis: It's revealed that the android head belonged to a murder suspect. Two other androids were sent to retrieve the android head along with a horde of maid androids.

value.title: There Is Data That Cannot Be Deleted
value.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura, and the robot tinkerer head towards the main facility of the inventor and attempt to shutdown the rampaging maid android mob.

value.title: Let`s Drive There / Doggy Meatballs Have a Fragrant Smell
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - Sadaharu is in "heat" and Yorozuya tries to find him a mate.

Part 2 - Katsura attempts to take a driving lesson -- a "Might Happen" driving lesson, that is.

value.title: The Mushrooms Are Delicious
value.synopsis: While hunting mushrooms in the woods, Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura become infected with mentality-changing mushrooms while getting get involved in a tragic war between a bear and a hunter.

value.title: A Mangaka Has to Stock Up Enough Drafts to Be Qualified
value.synopsis: Edo's under attack by M-unibrow zombies!

value.title: Someone Said "Don`t Complain About Your Job at Home, Do It Somewhere Else" So Let Me Complain. It`s Already Been a Year Since This Anime, Which Began with, "Land of the Samurai. The Days When Our Country Was Called That Are Long Past." A Lot of Things Have Happened Since Then. So I Thought, It Might Be a Good Time to Look Back, but Then Someone Said, "Tsk, a Recap Episode. Isn`t That Slacking?" Look It`s Hard Work Putting Together an Anime, So Stop Complaining!
value.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura recaps what has happened to date on their 2nd Year Anniversary special.

value.title: Quietly Cook Red-Bean Rice at This Time
value.synopsis: Otae's childhood friend, Kyubei Yagyu appears and takes Otae back to fufil her childhood promise.

value.title: Yesterday`s Enemy Is Also Today`s Enemy
value.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura, Kondo, Hijikata and Sogo goes to the Yagyu family premises and attempts to get Otae back.

value.title: A Person Who`s Picky with Food Is Also Picky with Humans.
value.synopsis: The battle at the Yagyu family premises continues.

value.title: If There`s Four People, It Is a Lot of Knowledge
value.synopsis: Gintoki, Isao, Toujou, and Binbokusai are in the toilet, all looking for something to wipe....

value.title: A Person That Wears Glasses Suddenly Takes the Glasses Off, It Feels Like Something Is Missing. Like the Part of the Person Is Missing.
value.synopsis: The battle between Gintoki and Binbokusai begins; meanwhile, Shinpachi discovered that Kyubei was girl.

value.title: A Woman`s Best Make Up Is the Smile
value.synopsis: The final episode in the Yagyu story arc.

value.title: It`s Not Like I Line Up for Ramen. I Line Up for Satisfy Myself.
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - The Yorozuya attempt to rid a town of monsters for some quick cash

Part 2 - The piggish Amanto female saved by the Yorozuya from the drug pirates enlists them to save her boyfriend from his former gang.

value.title: Rank Has Nothing to Do With Luck
value.synopsis: The cold/flu season hits hard; Yorozuya is enlisted to help out at Otae's workplace.

value.title: Hard-boiled Egg on a Man`s Heart
value.synopsis: A washed out detective tells his tale about his life-long quest of pursuing of a thief who turned from righteous to evil.

value.title: Hard-Boiled Egg Won`t Get Crashed
value.synopsis: The detective, Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura crashed into a mansion in an attempt to capture the thief.

value.title: There Are Many Instances Where You Cannot Get to Sleep Even After Counting Sheep
value.synopsis: Sougo's older sister, Mitsuba, arrived in Edo for a visit. Hijikata and Mitsuba's relationship is revealed.

value.title: Use German Suplex on Women Who Like to Ask Which Is Important, Me or Work
value.synopsis: Mitsuba is in bad condition due to her sickness; Sougo decides to go help Hijikata.

value.title: The Start Is Always the Happiest in Joint Parties
value.synopsis: Tojo Ayumu enlisted the help of Yorozuya to help make a "woman" out of the tomboyish Kyubei. Gintoki's solution: a Gokon.

value.title: When There`s Two, There Will Be Three
value.synopsis: The spirit of the sword that Gintoki carries appears to teach Gintoki, Shinpachi and Kagura an ultimate technique.

value.title: It`s Scary to Eat the Wrong Food When It`s So Delicious
value.synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura and Hasegawa are hospitalized (The Yorozuya gang for food poisoning from eating unfresh crabs; Hasegawa got knocked down by a car). They get themselves involved when a young nurse falls in love with one of her patients.

value.title: If You Want to Slim Down, Go and Exercise, Do Not Eat
value.synopsis: Our female characters joined a "slimming" camp to shed off their extra weights.

value.title: Become a Person Who Is Able to Find a Person`s Merits Rather Than His Weak Points
value.synopsis: An assassin has been hired to kill Matsudaira but encounters unexpected scenarios while carrying out the task.

value.title: Even Heroes Have Their Own Problems
value.synopsis: It's Valentine's Day, and a space heroine comes to Edo to confess her intention to...

value.title: When You Are Sitting on the Train, Both Hands Must Be Strapped
value.synopsis: Hasegawa gets a job. While commuting on his first day, an accident lands him in jail with harassment charges.

value.title: Men Are Madao
value.synopsis: The trial of Hasegawa's harassment charge comes to a conclusion.

value.title: If You Are a Man, Do Not Give Up
value.synopsis: A planet is attacked by mysterious beings. It's up to Umibouzu to settle things and put an end to the attack. How will the end turn out?

value.title: Heroic Stories of the Past Are Exaggerated by Three Folds / Boys Are Weak Towards Girls from a Flower Shop or a Cake Shop
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - Old gangmates of Catherine try to convince her to join them on a heist.

Part 2 - Gintoki gets sick. Kagura takes over running odd-jobs for the day.

value.title: Game Is an Hour Per Day
value.synopsis: The popular game console "Owee" is finally on sale. The otaku, as well as the Yorozuya and the Shinsengumi are at the store trying to get their hands on the consoles.

value.title: Life as Well as Games Are Only Bugs
value.synopsis: Yorozuya and Shinsengumi are divided into two teams to play against each other in a video-gaming contest for a chance to win a free "Owee".

value.title: Those Who Are Disliked Are Always Adorable
value.synopsis: Gintoki gives his suggestions to the editor and author of "Gintaman" on what should the series improve on.

value.title: Law Exists to Be Violated
value.synopsis: Some Shinsengumi member shows up, and it is soon revealed to be a rival of Hijikata.

value.title: Otakus Are Talkative
value.synopsis: Itou Kamotarou (appeared on the previous episode) proceeds with his agenda. Hijikata seeks help from the Yorozuya to save the Shinsengumi from destruction.

value.title: The Difference Between Strengths and Weaknesses Is Only a Thin Line
value.synopsis: Okita appears to save Kondou from the rebel Shinsengumi led by Itou. The Yorozuya along with Hijikata are also on their way to the scene.

value.title: Important Things Are Hard to See
value.synopsis: Now fully free from the curse, Hijikata battles against Itou. Meanwhile, Gintoki is forced into a confrontation with none other than Bansai, right hand man to Takasugi.

value.title: Anything Depends on the Beat and the Timing
value.synopsis: The concluding finale to the Shinsengumi Crisis Arc.

value.title: Most People I Love Sudden Death
value.synopsis: Kagura accidentally knocks out an international soccer team when their captain was out by giving them water from a janitor's bucket. Now the Yorozuya and others have to fill the team's spots.

value.title: Parents, Not Knowing the Child
value.synopsis: The Yorozuya are requested to help a Yakuza boss's son who has become a hikikomori, but little do they know how dangerous this job could turn out to be...

value.title: Better Leave It Unsaid
value.synopsis: The Yorozuya's Yakuza client has died, and the group's young new leader carries a dark secret about the boss's son.

value.title: Life Is a Test
value.synopsis: Yamazaki, with the intent of spying on the Joui faction, undergoes the necessary testing and training as one of its new recruits.

value.title: Everyone Is an Escapee of a Prison Called "Myself"
value.synopsis: Katsura is inprisoned, and fellow inmate Suekichi tries to find a way to make Katsura fall asleep so that he can make his escape.

value.title: Definitely Do Not Let Your Girlfriend See the Things You Use for Crossdressing / There`s Almost a 100% Chance of Forgetting One`s Vinyl Umbrella and Then Hating Oneself
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - Yorozuya's asked by a crossdresser hostess to help with the courting of a host. 

Part 2 - A story about Kagura and an umbrella during the rainy season.

value.title: A Birthday in Your Twenties Has No Deep Meaning / You`re Lucky If You Can Stay Up Late to Work
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - Katsura briefly takes over the series in an attempt to promote his birthday.

Part 2 - Gintoki attempts to help Tama find a way to enjoy herself.

value.title: The Act of Polishing a Urinal Is Like the Act of Polishing One`s Heart / Subtitle Undecided
value.synopsis: A member of the Shinsengumi suggests a "washroom revolution". Eventually it evolves into a battle of Shinsengumi vs. washroom germs.

value.title: They Say Soy Sauce on Pudding Tastes Like Sea Urchin, but Soy Sauce on Pudding Only Tastes Like Pudding and Soy Sauce
value.synopsis: Hijikata tells Matsudaira that he would fend off the store clerks who are coming-on to Matsudaira's daughter, Kuriko, just so he'd spare their lives. Kuriko mistakes Hijikata as some other person and starts to have feelings for him.

value.title: The Time Just Before the Summer Holidays Start Is the Most Fun
value.synopsis: While Gintoki, Shinpachi, Kagura, Hasegawa, Tae, Kyuubei and Katsura are on their way to the legendary Dragon Palace, a quarrel between them ends up bringing them onto an isolated island.

value.title: The Older, the Wiser
value.synopsis: Kamenashi (the turtle) tells the group about Otohime, the owner of the Dragon Palace, and that they are the only ones who are capable of stopping her plan.

value.title: Beauty Is Like a Summer Fruit
value.synopsis: The group goes to save Tae. On their way, Shinpachi, Gintoki and Katsura stumble upon a room where they learn about Otohime's past.

value.title: Be as Straightforward as Your Back Is Bent
value.synopsis: Otohime's past lover's will gives the antidote to the aging virus to Shinpachi. However, their time is limited as a missile carrying another batch of the virus aimed at Edo is about to be sent off.

value.title: Those Who Smoke One or Two Cigarettes Are Putting the Smell of Horse Dung in Them
value.synopsis: Smoking ban comes to Edo. Heavy smoker Hijikata is desperate to find cigarettes.

value.title: The Taste of Overseas Japanese Restaurants Is Generally at the Same Level as a School Cafeteria / Once You`ve Chosen a Dish, You Can`t Give It Back
value.synopsis:
Part 1 - Katsura goes undercover at an Amanto-only Japanese restaurant to stop a radical branch of the Joi Faction's plan of causing havoc. 

Part 2 - Hasegawa takes over a sushi bar while the owner is in the hospital. The Yorozuya end up helping after the sushi machine went out of order.
